research_notes: Initial review2026-10-01: frozen roster has no occupation entries. Built chronology from firm biographies, first speech, professional profile, own2007article, historical government annual reports and community/employer material. No roster refresh.

Retirement conflict resolved provisionally toward30June2026: explicit first-person first speech agrees with home/team firm notices; services/contact notices say30July. Preserve both URLs and revisit if corrected. Null end dates elsewhere mean unknown, not necessarily still active.

No substantive full-time evidence found for private firms or internet businesses. Multiple simultaneous board/advisory/spokesperson/study commitments recorded without assuming they reduced hours by a specific fraction. Principal/director titles and continuous business existence do not prove full-time employment. Government and nonprofit legal clients are clients, not employers.

Public professional searches and employer profiles attempted for earlier firms, business names and hours. Unsolicited contact-aggregator results suggested WebologyAustralia1999–2001, Coadys2005–2007 and Hillwood residents association2010–2013, but those claims remain leads pending independent primary confirmation; no aggregator contact data gathered. Own biography supports broader internet-company period1998–2001. Earlier jobs and1993–1996/2001–2003 chronology remain open.

Primary ARBV reports resolve Consumer Affairs board identity and2012end; do not mistakenly attribute adjacent table government-architect role to Bleyer. Community Care primary newsletter supports voluntary board role; payment for other appointments remains unknown. Migration-agent registration2017 is a credential within law practice, not a separate employment interval.

Follow-up: school-job employers and dates; all internet company identities/control/hours; early law articles/traineeship and precise firms’ dates/status/leave; remuneration and exit for external roles; Hillwood lead; retirement page correction. Last review2026-10-01. Next initial record Carol Brown.

Follow-up2026-10-02: targeted primary professional-profile indexing independently resolves Coadys2005–2007, Webology Australia1999–2001 within broader internet-company period, and Hillwood association board2010–2013. No contact aggregator used as final evidence. Unknown hours/control/legal payroll and overlaps preserved; private totals remain null.

Contemporary2005professional article located through Lawyers for Forests; image-only copy did not supply usable additional employment text, AustLII direct reader Internal Error. LinkedIn direct fetch999; accessible public index used.2024Community Care financial-report lead inaccessible through web tool;2025Landcare AGM lists board participation but no exit. These are source gaps, not terminal errors. Next seek early traineeship/school jobs, other internet employer, contracts/hours and external-role exits.

Follow-up2026-10-04: the primary Architects Registration Board2006–07 report narrows Bleyer's board appointment to September2006 and records9of10meetings attended. This improves governance chronology only; meeting attendance does not establish hours, remuneration or ordinary public employment. Exact school employers, the other internet company, legal traineeship, private-practice hours/leave and external-role exits remain unresolved.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Primary Landcare Tasmania May2023 newsletter identifies separate volunteer work at the Agfest stall with Greens Beach Landcare, previously omitted from the completeness chronology. Added event-observation spell without converting month into start/end dates. Exact-name internet-company, school-job, private legal-hours and CCT2024 searches supplied no new reliable employer or hours boundary; unrelated name-only results rejected. Continue seeking historical Webology legal entity and primary law-employment conditions; no total inferred.
